hypothesis: Descriptive win rate of fading the first wick sweep of a confirmed swing.
baseline: 50 percent gross breakeven for ideal symmetric barrier fills.
entry_timeframe: 15 minutes from observed Forex Tester M1, no synthetic candles.
entry_rules: Default Only Wicks, Swings=5. Confirmed pivots, rightmost tie, strict penetration and close back. Wick once, close beyond invalidates, evaluate before removing age >2000. Merge same-side signals, skip two-sided bars. At next observed M15 open enter in reversal direction if flat, positive risk and both bars in same period. Warm up each three-year period with 60 prior calendar days (over 2006 observed M15 bars). Partial nonempty M15 buckets retained; next observed open includes weekend gaps.

exit_rules.barriers: Sweep bar extreme for SL, equal-distance TP. Check M1 opens first, adverse gaps at open, favorable gaps at target. Same minute ambiguity resolved stop first. Period end close.

final_period_prior_exposure: Historical periods previously used in this repository.
cost_and_fill_model: Round trip fixed 1.0 pip deducted after exit. No additional variable spread, slippage, commissions or financing. Pip 0.01 JPY and 0.0001 others.
position_sizing_and_currency: Each trade has one unit of initial risk; aggregate gross and net R.
acceptance_gates: Descriptive study only; report counts, gross and net win rates, net PF in R. Strictly positive P/L counts as win, zero remains in denominator.
cross_symbol_rule: Pool all closed trades by count; also summarize per symbol and period.
